title: FAIRCAUSESYN: TOWARDS CAUSALLY FAIR LLM-AUGMENTED SYNTHETIC DATA GENERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating causal fairness by computing path-specific metrics (Total Variation, Direct Effect, Indirect Effect, and Spurious Effect) through a Standard Fairness Model (SFM) to quantify the direct, mediated, and confounded influences of a patient's sex on clinical survival outcomes.
